query:
UPDATE candidate_news SET sourceName = 
  CASE 
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%yahoo.com%' THEN 'Yahoo新聞'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%ettoday%' THEN 'ETtoday'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%setn.com%' THEN '三立新聞'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%ltn.com%' THEN '自由時報'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%udn.com%' THEN '聯合新聞網'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%chinatimes%' THEN '中時新聞網'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%tvbs%' THEN 'TVBS'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%newtalk%' THEN '新頭殼'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%cna.com%' THEN '中央社'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%storm.mg%' THEN '風傳媒'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%mirrormedia%' THEN '鏡週刊'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%ctinews%' THEN '中天新聞'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%nownews%' THEN 'NOWnews'
    WHEN sourceUrl LIKE '%appledaily%' OR sourceUrl LIKE '%nextapple%' THEN '蘋果新聞'
    ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sourceUrl, '://', -1), '/', 1)
  END
WHERE sourceName = 'vertexaisearch';
